code.title: Introducing FerixCode
code.description: A powerful CLI for development with Ralph loops. Built on top of Claude, Cursor & OpenCode.
code.feature1Description: Start a task and step away. Perfect for long-running jobs that complete while you're AFK.
code.feature2Description: Works with Claude, Cursor, and OpenCode. Use your preferred AI provider with a single flag.
code.feature3Description: From task to PR in one command. Create branches, run tests, and open pull requests automatically.

sync.title: Introducing Sync
sync.description: Auto-discover and install skills from your project dependencies. All of your skills in one command.
sync.feature1Description: Scans your package.json and automatically finds relevant skill repositories for your dependencies.
sync.feature2Description: Resolves package organizations via npm registry with intelligent caching for fast lookups.
sync.feature3Description: Installs all discovered skills with a single command. Works locally or globally.
